body:
Record the 1965 Heidenheim–Marmorstein scan inventory, faithful Hebrew/English readings, textual corrections, alignment decisions and independent review evidence for opensiddur/opensiddur-processor#214.

All currently encoded material is accepted: **766 literal witnesses and 145 canonical realization payloads**, covering **276 of 355 scan pages** (PDF 1–275 plus appendix pilot 351). Human questions through 414 are settled. The remaining 79 pages are unencoded; next is Zikhronot on PDF 276. Raw source pointing and documentary variants are preserved; missing translations remain absent. The earlier 720 literal witnesses are unchanged in this installment.

`musaf_s252_s275_acceptance.json` and `progress.json` record current acceptance. The previous 254-complete-page count included two partial leaves; the complete count before this installment was 252. Review verdicts, rejected intermediate findings, resolutions, current payload hashes, conditional/source-boundary checks and full PDF/electronic QA evidence are committed. Images and generated exports remain outside Git. Historical draft records are superseded by the current acceptance record.

Paired implementation: opensiddur/opensiddur-processor#296. Generated projects: opensiddur/opensiddur-projects#102. Preview exporter fixes are separate processor PRs 310/312/313. This PR remains draft while the full volume continues.
